name: Song Yadong

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (68 in height, 67 in reach, born 1997-12-02); fight weight = bantamweight limit 135 lb

photo_coverage: Good. Official studio headshot and two full-body cut-outs (2024-25 kit), two freely licensed photos from UFC Macau on 30 May 2026 (CC BY 4.0: a soft-light three-quarter of his right side at the post-fight press conference and a walkout photo), a near-profile of his left side from the UFC Shanghai weigh-in face-off (Aug 2026, the most recent), a May 2026 face-off pose and a 2023 fight photo. No clean right-side profile.

face.shape: Long oval-to-rectangular face, medium width: widest at the cheekbones, with a defined, fairly squared jaw that narrows only slightly to the chin. Lean, with flat cheeks and soft hollows under the cheekbones.
face.jaw: Clean, defined jawline with visible angles below the ears; not especially wide. Masseter shows as a firm line from ear to chin.
face.chin: Medium width, rounded-square, moderately tall; in profile (Shanghai) it sits slightly behind the line of the lips, i.e. average to mildly soft projection.
face.cheekbones: Broad and moderately high; the face is widest here in the frontal headshot. Cheeks lift into firm round apples when he smiles (Macau presser).
face.brow_ridge: Low-moderate; the brow area is fairly flat in profile, the brows themselves sit close above the eyes.
face.forehead: Medium height, fairly upright and smooth in profile; straight hairline across.

eyes.shape: Narrow, horizontally long almond eyes with a small visible aperture; the upper lid fold covers the lid with little or no visible crease, and a small fold covers the inner corners. Outer corners level to very slightly raised. Not deep-set; no notable bags.
eyes.spacing: Average to slightly wide (a little more than one eye-width apart).
eyes.colour: Dark brown, near black in all photos. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and nearly straight, with a slight lift over the outer third; the inner ends start close to the nose root.
eyebrows.colour: Black (patch sample #5c3f35 includes skin between hairs; render near #1a1414)

nose.width: Medium at the bridge, medium-wide at the nostrils
nose.bridge: Straight, moderate height, slightly low at the root in profile
nose.fight_damage: None obvious in the photos; no visible deviation.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth. Upper lip thin-to-medium with a clear cupid's bow, lower lip a little fuller. Resting expression closed and neutral; wide, toothy smile that pushes the cheeks up (Macau presser and walkout).

ears.size: Medium-large; they stand out from the head noticeably at the top in frontal photos and sit well back on the head in profile.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower ear in the studio headshot; the helix and folds look smooth.

face.marks_scars: No facial scars visible. Short thin pale linear scar on the upper left chest below the collarbone (studio stance-right and headshot).

hair.style: Short skin fade on the back and sides (high taper), longer top brushed up and slightly back into a spiky, textured crest. Top was about 4-5 cm in the studio shoot; in Aug 2026 (Shanghai) the top is a little longer and stands up higher with sharply shaved sides; shorter and flatter in May 2026.
hair.colour_note: Jet black with no visible brown cast; samples read almost pure black, so a soft black (#141010) is suggested for rendering.
hair.hairline: Straight, medium height, slightly squared at the temples with no recession.
hair.texture: Straight, thick and coarse; stands up on its own.

facial_hair.density: Clean-shaven in all photos; faint shadow only on the upper lip.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit cheeks and a soft-light forehead; specular flash forehead and a bright highlight excluded); each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Light-medium skin with a warm golden tone; torso reads a little deeper and more tanned than the face in the studio photos.
skin.freckles_marks: Very little body hair on the chest; visible dark hair on the forearms, thighs and shins. Small scar on the upper left chest (see face.marks_scars).

body.build: Lean, athletic and very well muscled for a 173 cm bantamweight: compact, defined, not bulky.
body.body_fat_note: Very low: full six-to-eight-pack, obliques and serratus clearly visible in both studio cut-outs and at the Aug 2026 weigh-in.
body.shoulders: Broad for his height with full round deltoids and a visible upper trapezius; clear V-taper.
body.chest: Flat, well-defined pectorals with a sharp lower edge; almost hairless.
body.arms: Muscular, with full biceps and triceps for his size and strong forearms; reach (170 cm) slightly shorter than height.
body.legs_calves: Muscular thighs with visible separation above the knee, strong calves; legs proportionate to the torso.
body.posture: Upright, chest open, shoulders slightly forward and relaxed; head held level. In the studio shots the arms hang with a slight bend at the elbow and the hands loosely closed.
body.notable: The strongest likeness cues are the jet-black spiky top with a high fade, narrow dark eyes under low straight brows, broad cheekbones on a long face, and a very defined lean torso.

stance_and_guard.observed: Studio cut-outs: weight even, arms hanging with a slight bend. May 2026 face-off: both fists up at chest height, forearms near horizontal, elbows bent about 90 degrees and close to the ribs, shoulders rolled forward, chin level. Dec 2023 fight photo: lead (left) hand drops to the hip mid-exchange while the head moves off line.
stance_and_guard.animation_hint: Compact orthodox guard: gloves at cheek-to-chin height between exchanges, elbows tucked to the ribs, shoulders slightly hunched forward; do not hold the hands wide or stiffly high. Only one fight photo, so treat details as low confidence.

tattoos.where: Left thigh, front and outer side just above the knee
tattoos.description: Black-ink illustrative piece (what appears to be wrapped fists or forearms in dark ink with a little red) above curved lettering that starts THE PAIN IS NEEDED TO (end of the line not readable).

tattoos.where: Left lower leg, inner shin and calf
tattoos.description: Long vertical ornamental design in black with a red-tinted motif near the top and scroll-like curls running down the shin.

kit.fight_shorts_recent: Studio: black 2024-25 UFC Venum kit (black with dark-grey scale/wave pattern, white-check waistband, crypto.com logo). May 2026 Macau weigh-in: red and black patterned shorts. Aug 2026 Shanghai weigh-in: white shorts with a black graphic pattern.
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves (red cuffs when in the red corner).
kit.weigh_in_media: Gold chain with a pendant at weigh-ins (Macau 2026); black UFC/Venum jacket or black tee at media; sometimes mirrored sport sunglasses at media day.

morphs_height_note: macro/heightDownM 0.13 from the research/assets.md male fit heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 with H = 1.727 m; drop it if the avatar code scales to the tale of the tape directly. ageOldM = (28 - 25) / 65. eyebrows-angle-up/down are used here to mean the outer end of the brow goes up/down; flip if the target does the opposite. eyes/*-epicanthus-in is meant to add the small inner-corner fold seen in the headshot; check visually and reduce if it distorts the lid.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. His medium-large ears stand out at the top; if ear targets are added use about ears/l-ear-scale-incr and ears/r-ear-scale-incr 0.15 and ears/l-ear-rot-forward and ears/r-ear-rot-forward 0.15. No cauliflower.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male or middleage_asian_male (neither is a close match; choose by texture detail) tinted toward #cd9174; slightly deeper and warmer on the torso
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 tinted #1a1414, low and nearly straight, dense
render_hints.hair: short02 or short04 with the sides cut to a high skin fade and the top standing up about 4-5 cm, tinted #141010

notes: Confidence: high for hair, eye shape, brows, skin tone and physique (clear studio photos plus two freely licensed May 2026 photos and an Aug 2026 profile). Medium for profile details (nose projection, chin) because the only profile is a video still. Watch for: (1) jet-black hair with a high fade and a spiky raised top, never flat or parted; (2) narrow dark eyes with a covered upper lid, under low straight thick brows; (3) long face with broad cheekbones and lean flat cheeks, defined jaw; (4) ears that stand out at the top; (5) a very lean, defined but compact 173 cm torso; tattoos only on the left leg; (6) clean-shaven.

stance.notes: Power boxer-puncher: high tight guard, explosive entries with hooks and overhands, counters off the rear hand.
stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 (avatar pass v4) from his documented fighting style (data/scouting/song-yadong.json where present) and the reference photos in assets/reference/song-yadong/ (ref-zuffa-gutierrez-fight-2023-12-09.jpg: rear glove pinned high to the cheek while throwing). The base stance (orthodox/southpaw) is left to the roster data. Fight footage would sharpen these values.
